ar: مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ وَ الْمُهَاجِرِيْنَ ، وَعَنِ التَّابِعِيْنَ لَهُمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ وَاحْشُرْنَا وَ ارْحَمْنَا مَعَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ . يَا اَللّٰهُ . يَا حَيُّ . يَا قَيُّوْمُ . لَآ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ .
tr: min ‘l-Anṣāri wa ‘l-Muhājirīna, Wa `ani ‘t-Tābi`īna lahum bi iḥsānin ilā Yawmi ‘d-Dīni, Wa ‘ḥshurnā wa ‘rḥamnā ma`ahum, Bi Raḥmatika Yā Arḥam ‘r-Rāhimīna, Yā Allāhu, Yā Ḥayyu, Yā Qayyūmu, Lā ilāha illā Ant.
en: among the Helpers (Ansar), Migrants (Muhajireen) and those who follow them in goodness until the Day of Judgement! And gather us and have mercy upon us with them, by Your Mercy, O Most Merciful of The Profoundly Merciful! O Allah! O Living, Self-Sustaining! There is no god but You!
